article_context: Body image for the section debunking the idea that breast milk is unaffected by a fast-food diet. It supports the message that a varied, nourishing diet and balanced choices matter, without treating any food as absolutely forbidden.
image_reading: A woman seated at a table raises an open hand to decline a slice of pizza being offered from the right.
Healthy foods—fruit, vegetables, a green drink and cereal—fill the foreground, contrasting with the pizza.
Her attentive, mildly disapproving expression and the clear hand gesture make the refusal the natural motion focus.

models.positive_prompt: The woman calmly completes a single open-palm refusal gesture toward the offered pizza, then keeps her attention on the healthy food. Fixed camera. By the final frame, the pizza remains declined at the edge of the frame and her hand is held in a clear stop position.
models.scene_plan: Over five seconds, her raised hand makes one measured outward stop gesture toward the pizza while her gaze settles on the food in front of her. Keep the camera fixed and the table arrangement stable. The gesture resolves near the end with the pizza still held back at the right edge and her refusal clearly readable.

models.positive_prompt: With a calm, firm expression, the woman gently holds up her palm to decline the offered pizza and turns her gaze toward the nourishing food on the table. Fixed camera; end with the pizza still refused at the frame edge.
models.scene_plan: For this five-second shot, develop one calm refusal: the woman eases her open palm toward the incoming pizza and subtly redirects her attention to the fruit and vegetables. Use a fixed camera and an even pace. Close on the sustained stop gesture, with the pizza visibly kept away from her.

models.positive_prompt: Fixed camera on the woman as she makes one gentle, deliberate stop gesture toward the pizza, keeping a composed, discerning expression. Her gaze settles on the healthy food; in the final frame the pizza is clearly declined at the right edge.
models.scene_plan: Within four seconds, show one focused action: her raised palm completes a restrained refusal of the pizza as her attention shifts toward the healthy spread. Keep the camera still and the movement moderate. The final moment holds the unmistakable declined-pizza pose without changing her composed judgment.

structured_intent.editorial_meaning: Mindful, varied nourishment is a better everyday support than relying on fast food, while avoiding an absolutist view of food.
structured_intent.primary_action: The woman calmly declines the offered slice of pizza with one open-palm gesture.
structured_intent.semantic_invariant: Her composed, discerning preference for balanced nourishment remains clear throughout.
structured_intent.terminal_state: The pizza is still held back at the right edge while her raised palm visibly signals refusal.
